body: -- Founder: 'the live reload kind of snaps a bunch in when it loads a bunch in can we animate them in... on a jitter?' / 'section by section not snapping all 3 sections in at once'. Explains the earlier flicker report a real MutationObserver investigation found no DOM bug for -- the patch was already clean, the arrival just had zero transition. New cardEntranceCSS fade-in keyframe + staggered per-section (index) / per-card (subject/style) insertion with a jittered 1.5-5s delay. Commit 8973376, deployed and re-rendered live.
title: New cards/sections stagger in with a jittered fade-in, no more instant snap-in
